name: read_symbol
description: Default primitive for reading a code symbol with version, outline, and safe fallback. Resolves by stable symbol_id or name+file, returns body with exact file hash / symbol body_hash (version anchors), index freshness, pipeline trace, and budget truncation. Non-code files degrade to line_range/file reads. Use read_outline only when you need full file structure without editing.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

name.description: Symbol name (used with file_path when symbol_id unknown)

line_range.description: Degraded line_range read for non-code files: [start, end] 1-based inclusive

mode.description: core (default): body + version, no outline (saves tokens). rich: adds outline + navigation counts.

include_outline.description: Include file outline summary. Default: off in core mode, on in rich mode. Set true to force.

budget_hint.description: Max body chars to return; must truncate, not hint (default 1200)

source.description: live (default): read current file + check staleness. indexed: read-only snapshot, never use for write.

on_ambiguous.description: fail (default): return candidates, never silently pick.
